summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing of Framewright (no backend, so backend testing skipped). Verified: (1) the navigation-glitch fix in Shell.jsx across 5 slow Home->Studio->Preview->Home cycles, 18 rapid-fire cross-route clicks, and 50ms-interval DOM polling of every Studio->Home and Studio->Preview transition - only ONE .page-shell exists at any instant, content length never drops to 0, no stale cross-route markup after the transition settles, and ZERO console/page errors; (2) landing hero border-trail removal (0 .trail elements, hero-console ::before content='none', animation='none'); (3) dropzone copy 'PNG, JPG or WEBP · max 8MB'; (4) accent-colour disclosure (collapsed default, correct DOM order between Section name and Generate, 5 presets, hex label, Reset appears/clears, accent propagates into the preview iframe srcDoc); (5) Live Preview panel always present with iframe at idle, 3-way breakpoint toggle resizing + centering the frame, page/section names live-bound; (6) all 5 pipeline job states via the dev switcher with correct pill tone, 7 correctly-named stage nodes, amber degraded node, stage inspector strip (input/output/model/confidence/warning), needs-input question card + 3 selectable choices, DONE tab bar (Stages/Code/Content), read-only code snippet + copy, content field dropdown with Headline/Supporting copy/CTA label, live headline sync into the iframe (verified inside the frame's rendered h1), FAILED error banner with red X at stage 4; (7) the real ~3.4s Generate run progressing stage-by-stage and auto-landing on DONE; (8) job history 3 items/3 READY badges; (9) login mock auth + avatar logout. FAILURES: unhandled clipboard promise rejection on the code copy button, and four CSS layout/overflow defects (composer field grid on desktop, live-preview frame + stage timeline + code box at 390px).

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard?.writeText(code) result is never awaited/caught. When the Clipboard API rejects (permission denied, non-secure or non-focused context) the unhandled promise rejection surfaces as a full-screen CRA 'Uncaught runtime errors: NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied' overlay that blocks ALL further interaction with the page (Playwright clicks were intercepted by #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay for 30s). The button also optimistically shows 'Copied' even when the copy failed. Needs .then/.catch with a fallback + failure state.

Desktop 1920px: the two inputs overflow the composer panel and the 'Section name' input is visibly clipped at the panel edge. Measured fields-grid scrollWidth=390 vs clientWidth=348; section input right=781 vs panel right=760. Cause: .field inputs have no width:100% and the grid columns/label have no min-width:0, so the browser's default input intrinsic width (~177px x2 + 10px gap) exceeds the 1fr 1fr track.

Selecting Mobile (360px) or Tablet (720px) breakpoint on a 390px viewport widens the whole document instead of scrolling inside the frame wrap: documentElement.scrollWidth becomes 456px (Mobile) and 816px (Tablet) vs clientWidth 390px. .live-preview-frame-wrap has overflow:auto but grows past the viewport because .studio-right-column / .studio-layout grid children lack min-width:0.

The timeline does NOT scroll horizontally as intended - it stretches the page. Measured scrollWidth == clientWidth == 614px inside a 390px viewport, and page scrollWidth becomes 672px. overflow-x:auto is set but the flex/grid ancestors have no min-width:0, so the track expands to the content width.
DONE > Code tab at 390px: code box clientWidth=407 > viewport 390, page scrollWidth=465 - horizontal page overflow. <pre> needs overflow-x:auto plus min-width:0 on the ancestor chain.

issues: In IDLE the panel reserves ~540px height with the empty state floating and a large dead void; in DONE/Stages the timeline ends around y=410 leaving ~200px of empty panel below it. The panel appears to be height-matched to the Live Preview panel, producing a lot of unbalanced whitespace. Consider height:auto or vertically centering the content.

AnimatePresence mode='wait' keeps the OUTGOING page mounted for ~250-300ms AFTER the URL has already changed, so users see the previous page content while the address bar/active nav pill already reflect the new route. Not the reported blank flash (never blank, never stale after settling), but it reads as lag on Home->Studio. Consider shortening exit duration to ~0.12s.

action_items: PipelinePanel CodeTab: guard the clipboard write with .catch() (and only set 'Copied' on success) - the unhandled rejection currently throws a blocking runtime-error overlay.
App.css: give .field input/textarea width:100% and add min-width:0 to .fields-grid children so the Section name input stops overflowing the composer panel on desktop.

studio.css: add min-width:0 to .studio-layout > *, .studio-right-column > * (and the pipeline/live-preview panels) so the fixed-width preview frame, the stage timeline and the code <pre> scroll inside their containers instead of widening the document at 390px.
Optional: reduce the AnimatePresence exit duration and/or the pipeline panel's reserved empty height.
critical_code_review_comments: Studio.jsx generate(): the setInterval is created inside an event handler and is never stored in a ref or cleared on unmount. Navigating away mid-run (Studio -> Home) leaves the interval alive and calling setState on an unmounted tree until it self-clears ~3.4s later. Wrap it in a ref + useEffect cleanup.

Studio.jsx generate(): clicking 'Generate section' repeatedly starts multiple concurrent intervals that fight over runningIndex. Disable the button (or clear the previous timer) while jobState === 'running'.

mock.js buildPreviewDoc(): page/section/headline/subtext/cta are interpolated raw into the iframe HTML string. Even though the iframe is srcDoc-only mock data, this is an HTML-injection pattern - typing '' into Page name injects live markup. Escape the values and add sandbox="allow-same-origin" to the iframe.
PipelinePanel.jsx imports ChevronDown but never uses it (dead import).
The 'DEV · JOB STATE' switcher is shipped unconditionally in the UI; gate it behind an env flag (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') before any real release.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The reported navigation glitch (blank flash / stale content on Studio->Home and Studio->Preview) is FIXED and verified with 50ms DOM polling - do not re-litigate it, only smoke it. All 5 pipeline job states, the dev switcher, breakpoint toggle, accent colour disclosure, content->iframe headline sync, the 3.4s generate run and the login/logout flow all pass at 1920px. Remaining work is (a) the clipboard copy button's unhandled rejection (reproduce by clicking [data-testid=pipeline-code-copy-button] WITHOUT granting clipboard permissions - it raises the CRA error overlay which then blocks every subsequent click, so grant clipboard-read/clipboard-write in the browser context when testing anything after it), and (b) four CSS overflow defects: composer fields-grid at 1920px, and live-preview frame / stage-timeline / code box at 390px. Re-verify with document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth at 390px on the Studio route in mobile+tablet breakpoints and in the running/done pipeline states.
rca_of_the_issue: Navigation glitch: RESOLVED - Shell.jsx now clones the <Routes> child with a pinned location from useLocation(), so the exiting page keeps matching its old route during the AnimatePresence exit; polling confirmed exactly one .page-shell with non-zero content at all times. Clipboard bug RCA: CodeTab calls navigator.clipboard?.writeText(code) and discards the returned promise, so a NotAllowedError becomes an unhandled rejection that CRA's dev overlay renders as a modal iframe (#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) which intercepts all pointer events. Overflow bugs RCA: .studio-layout and .studio-right-column are CSS grids whose items default to min-width:auto; every child with an intrinsic content width (framer-motion's inline width:360/720px on .live-preview-frame, the 7-node flex timeline, the <pre> code block, and the default-sized text inputs in .fields-grid) therefore expands its grid track past the viewport instead of scrolling inside its overflow:auto container.
